title: Too small Not 9 ounces
text: Too small Not 9 ounces. [[VIDEOID:69b0b710d5c14d731ff0fe2433c35c43]] When I open the box and found the coffee maker I thought the design was very pretty however I thought wow this is small can’t make more than maybe 2 cups of coffee in this so I decided to measure it. See video it does not hold 9 ounces as it says it does in the description of the item if you need to make more than one or 2 cups of Turkish coffee this is not the coffee maker for you.

product_metadata.title: DEMMEX Thickest Copper Turkish Greek Arabic Coffee Pot Engraved Stovetop Coffee Maker Cezve Ibrik Briki with Wooden Handle & Wooden Spoon, for 3 People (Matte Copper)
features: Handmade Engraved Copper Stovetop Coffee Pot with Wooden Handle & Spoon. Made in Turkey.
1mm Thick Solid Pure Copper. Not Coated. So It will Develop a Natural Patina, as Real Copper Should. Lined with Food Safe Lead-Free Tin.
This Handmade Copper Pot will Last for Generations Unlike Other Thin Imitations. The DEMMEX Coffee Pot is Made with Thickest Copper Available. Thus, it has Maximum Durability.
Capacity : 9 fl .Oz (270 ml) for 3 people for 3 Demitasse Cups of Coffee. Diameter:3.5" Height : 2.8"

GUARANTEED COPPER - AUTHENTICITY TEST : After receiving the pot, if for any reason you think that it is not copper, drill a hole anywhere on the pot's body and check the hole. You will see 1mm thick copper along the hole. Nothing else. We will send you a replacement immediately if you decide to do this test and send us the photos afterwards. (This test should be done within 7 days of receiving the pot to avoid abuse of the replacement guarantee).
